svg.title: G1 - Cobalt Drift
svg.desc: The approved Kosmos symbol with a luminous Andromeda star cloud flowing across its lower body. Preview only.
svg.metadata: Texture: NASA/JPL/California Institute of Technology, GALEX, PIA04921. Source: https://images-assets.nasa.gov/image/PIA04921/PIA04921~medium.jpg. Artistic crop and color treatment.
